project.name: TMCP release and distribution
project.identity: The TMCP release boundary for standalone, plugin, and MCP-host distribution.
project.audience: Operators and consumers installing or validating TMCP releases.
project.core_loop: Compose a release, validate its evidence and compatibility, archive the result, and expose the supported distribution surface.
project.north_star: A released TMCP surface is identifiable, compatible, and backed by evidence that matches the shipped artifact.
not_this: Claiming hosted or installed parity from source alone

scope.purpose: Package, archive, and publish TMCP capabilities with release evidence that preserves compatibility and provenance.
scope.boundary: Owns release composition, archive, distribution, and compatibility-facing documentation; runtime product semantics and skill recommendation remain outside this child.
non_goals: Claiming hosted or installed parity from source alone

mvp.definition: The scoped boundary is explicitly ratified, its parent outcome is clear, and its smallest local proof is repeatable.

complete_product.definition: The scoped boundary remains aligned through changes, interfaces, and user-visible or consumer-facing verification.

outcomes.name: The TMCP release and distribution boundary advances its parent outcome without silently taking on sibling responsibilities.
